description: Update the documentation's contributor data files to reflect the latest community contributions. This involves refreshing the lists of contributors, translators, and translation reviewers with current information to ensure proper recognition of community members who have helped with the project.
functional_requirements: Update the contributors list with new contributors who have submitted code or documentation improvements
Update the translators list with individuals who have contributed translations to the documentation
Update the translation reviewers list with community members who have reviewed and validated translations
